title: 2013 Sci-Tech Awards: Matt Pharr, Greg Humphreys and Pat Hanrahan
summary: The Academy's 2014 Sci-Tech Awards segment honoring Matt Pharr, Greg Humphreys and Pat Hanrahan for their physically based rendering work and book. The authors give a short acceptance speech that thanks Donald Knuth for literate programming.
why: HN points to it as proof that the Physically Based Rendering book won an Oscar and for the speech crediting Knuth's literate programming.

quote.text: In their receiving speech they give a shout out to Donald Knuth for pioneering literate programming.
